newsitem.title: UK: APV wins Russian contracts worth 38 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: APV wins Russian contracts worth 38 mln stg.

text.p: Britain's APV Plc said on Monday it had been awarded three contracts worth 38 million stg from the Russian agency Selkhozpromexport.

The engineering and components group said the contracts are for the design, manufacture, supply and installation of equipment for the production of cereal and liquid based baby food for three plants located in St Petersburg, Ulyanovsk and Stavropol.
It said this took the total amount of business secured under the programme to around 70 million stg over the past twelve months.
